title: Tympanometry
what: A short test: a soft tip is placed in your ear and the air pressure is changed slightly. A machine checks how your eardrum moves.
why: For hearing loss, a blocked feeling in the ear, frequent ear infections in children, and when fitting a hearing aid.
duration: usually 2 to 5 minutes for both ears
tell_doctor: If your ear hurts or something is draining from it
If you recently had ear surgery

prepare.title: Ears
prepare.text: Do not clean your ears with cotton swabs before the test. If there is an earwax plug, the doctor will remove it.

prepare.title: For children
prepare.text: Tell your child it will tickle and press a little, like on a plane. It is important to sit quietly.

steps: The doctor looks in your ear
A soft tip is placed in your ear
You need to sit quietly, without talking or swallowing
The machine changes the pressure and records the result
The same is done with the other ear
feel: Light pressure in the ear, like when a plane takes off
Sometimes you hear a quiet hum or clicks
after: You can go back to your day right away
The result is usually given right away

faq.q: Can tympanometry be done on a child?
faq.a: Yes, even on babies. It is painless. The main thing is for the child to sit still for a couple of minutes.
Not exactly. It shows how the middle ear and eardrum work. Hearing is checked separately, with audiometry.
